Stock market news | Mahanadi Coalfields Set for Mumbai Debut After ₹8,981 Crore IPO

Mahanadi Coalfields Ltd., a unit of state-owned Coal India Ltd., is set to begin trading in Mumbai on Friday. The company raised ₹8,981 crore, or $969 million, through its initial public offering, with bidding closing on Monday.
